subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Tom is trying to ___________ as soon as possible.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**get a job**" is the most commonly used and contextually appropriate in this sentence.
 
• The other options are either grammatically incorrect or do not fit the context as naturally as "**get a job**."
 
• "**Experience a job**" and "**learn a job**" are not commonly used phrases.
 
• "**Receive a job**" is less common and does not fit as naturally as "**get a job**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Tom is trying to **get a job** as soon as possible."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "experience a job"** – This phrase is not commonly used and does not fit naturally in the context.
 
• **Option 2: "receive a job"** – This phrase is less common and somewhat awkward in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "learn a job"** – This phrase is not typically used to describe the process of obtaining employment.
